HOW IT WORKS

The model reasons.
Your assistant organizes the work.

Your assistant combines a model with the context, tools, workflow and checks that turn reasoning into reliable work. We call that execution system a harness. We design them around the standards your business uses to accept a result.

TWO LOOPS · ONE CONTROLLED SYSTEM

The assistant runs one version. The next version earns approval.

Doing the work and changing the system are separate activities.

SYSTEM DESIGN

Four parts to design together.

Model · reasoning

The model and reasoning budget matched to the task.

Information and tools · resources

Authorized sources, evidence links and available tools.

Workflow and permissions · boundaries

Execution steps, permission scope and human checkpoints.

Evaluation and feedback · evidence

Acceptance criteria, failure categories and regression checks.

This is a system design approach. It does not mean every task can improve automatically, or that model weights are continuously retrained.

More than a one-off answer.

An assistant shaped around your task

Task definitions, data and tool connections, permissions and human checkpoints.

Traceable execution
